name: Kameda Onihei
source:
A male servant who can be assigned to various housekeeping duties. His personality is insidious and perverted.

He has a hobby of installing surveillance cameras in the rooms of the women to whom he is assigned, and seizing their weaknesses to make them his flesh slaves.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onihei/index.html]official site[/url]]
